extra.inlet_airflow_note: UNRESOLVED. DSM50PG/1118 and /0113 print 'Inlet Airflow: 39.2 lb/sec (17.9 kg/sec)': kg and lb disagree - 39.2 lb/s = 17.78 kg/s, 17.9 kg/s = 39.46 lb/s. 17.9 kept as the printed kg figure (same convention as taurus70). Both figures exceed the same sheet's exhaust flow 63 700 kg/h = 17.69 kg/s (and BPGPH/0525 17.8 kg/s), although fuel adds ~0.25 kg/s (11.95 MJ/s LHV); mass balance would give ~17.4-17.6 kg/s. Not used by gtu_family.py (air = exhaust/(1+FAR)). Confirm with Solar before sizing the inlet.
extra.out_rpm_unverified: 14179 rpm (50 Hz) / 14186 rpm (60 Hz) - Modern Power Systems articles, seen only as search-index extracts; host not allowed in this session, not opened. Not in any opened Solar document.

starter.type: electric: 'Start System – Direct Drive AC Motor with VFD Control' (DSM50PG/1118, /0113); Turbomach 2012: 'Start system: AC'

extra.fuel: Natural gas (standard); landfill gas*, digester gas* (options). Turbomach 2012: NG/LBTU. Gas only - no liquid fuel listed.

variable_geometry.description: '10-Stage Axial Compressor – Variable Inlet Guide Vanes and Stators'

bearings.type: Engine: '2 Radial: Viscous Damped Roller Bearings' + '1 Thrust/Radial: Viscous Damped Split Inner Race Ball Bearing' (rolling-element bearings). Generator: Sleeve Bearings.

engine_removal.method: axial, out of the package end opposite the generator (which equipment sits at that end is not labelled on the drawing; 'axial' is read from the clearance strip lying along the package axis - the removal method is not described in text): drawing DSM50PG-003C shows a 4.9 m (16'0") long x 4.0 m (13'0") wide area beyond the 11.1 m package end labelled 'MINIMUM CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR ENGINE REMOVAL'; generator removal area 3.4 m (11'3") x 3.4 m (11'0") at the side of the generator end

extra.dp_note: 0 = rating basis 'No inlet/exhaust losses' (DSM50PG/1118), not a package duct loss. For steam-production figures Solar assumes: BPGPSG/116 (2016) inlet 100 mm H2O, exhaust 254 mm H2O, 'Mercury 50 175 mm (7 in.)'; BPGPH/0525 (2025) 100 mm / 254 mm H2O (no Mercury exception printed); Turbomach 2012: 75 / 250 mmH2O.
extra.generator: 4 pole, 3 phase, 6 wire, wye connected, synchronous with permanent magnet exciter; open drip-proof; sleeve bearings; 3300/6600/11000 V (50 Hz), 4160/6900/12470/13800 V (60 Hz)
extra.control: Turbotronic on-skid gas turbine control system (Turbotronic 4 in /0113 edition)
extra.nox_ppm: 5 ppm (BPGPH/0525, minimum engine capability on natural gas)
extra.rating_basis: ISO 15 C (59 F), sea level, RH 60%, no inlet/exhaust losses, natural gas LHV 35 MJ/Nm3 (940 Btu/scf), no accessory losses, efficiency measured at generator terminals
extra.pkg_basis: DSM50PG/1118: package height 3.7 m and weight 45 700 kg; the height basis is NOT printed on the Mercury sheet (unlike DS70PG/1118, which says 'enclosed height'); read as the enclosed package because the enclosure is standard scope ('Enclosure – Complete Package', no option mark) and the drawing is titled 'Enclosure Access and Maintenance Space'; dry/wet not stated on the sheet (BPGPSG/116 heads the same 3.7 m / 45 660 kg row 'Dry Weight'). BPGPH/0525 handbook: 3.5 m 'unenclosed height', 45,700 kg 'Dry weight'.
extra.md_variant: not offered: Mercury 50 is absent from the 'Compressor Set/Mechanical Drive Specifications' table of BIL/0622 (2022); MD/compressor-set rows list Saturn 20, Centaur 40/50, Taurus 60/70, Mars 90/100, Titan 130/250/350 only.

records.notes: Primary documents (opened): Solar data sheet DSM50PG/1118 (2018, scene7 CM20150710-52396-21070) - technically identical to DSM50PG/0113 (2013, scene7 C10553041) except control-system naming; cross-checked with BPGPH/0525 handbook (2025), BIL/0622 (2022), BPGPSG/116 (2016), Turbomach BPHBTBM/512 (2012). Manufacturer product page solarturbines.com not openable (Akamai 'Access Denied' 403 / empty reply to curl, DNS refused for WebFetch); its values seen only in search-index extracts: 4600 kWe, 8865 Btu/kWh (9350 kJ), 140,400 lb/hr (63,700 kg/hr), 690 F (365 C) - identical to DSM50PG/1118, which is the 'Power Generation Data Sheet' the page links. eff_pct 38.5 is PUBLISHED ('Engine efficiency: 38.5% (measured at generator terminals)'); 3600/9350 = 38.50 agrees. Exhaust flow editions: DSM50PG/1118 + product page 63 700 kg/hr (140,400 lb/hr) = 17.69 kg/s (unit conversion) - TAKEN per priority of the current manufacturer page; BPGPH/0525 handbook (2025) 17.8 kg/s (39.3 lb/s); BPGPSG/116 (2016) 64.1 thousand kg/hr (141.4 thousand lb/hr); Turbomach 2012 17.82 kg/s. Spread 17.69-17.82 kg/s (0.7%). Inconsistency as published: the same data sheet gives inlet airflow 39.2 lb/sec (17.9 kg/sec) - larger than its exhaust flow 17.69 kg/s, although fuel is added; check with Solar before sizing exhaust/recuperator interfaces. Exhaust temperature: 365 C (690 F) in DSM50PG, product page, BPGPSG/116; 365 C (689 F) in BPGPH/0525; 374 C in Turbomach 2012 (older, not taken). out_rpm: no opened document publishes the turbine/gearbox-input speed; only gearbox output 1500/1800 rpm. Earlier value 14179 (50 Hz) / 14186 (60 Hz) rpm came from Modern Power Systems search extracts (host not reachable) - moved to extra.out_rpm_unverified, field set to null. Package editions: DSM50PG/1118 and /0113: L 11.1 m (36'6"), W 3.2 m (10'5"), H 3.7 m (12'3"), 45 700 kg (100,700 lb) - TAKEN (package data sheet, enclosed); BIL/0622 and BPGPSG/116: 11.2 m (36'6"), 3.2 m, 3.7 m (12'3"), 45 660 kg (100,700 lb) - same imperial figures, different metric rounding; BPGPH/0525 handbook: 11.1 m (36'3"), 3.2 m (10'5"), 3.5 m (11'6") 'unenclosed height', 45,700 kg dry; Turbomach 2012: L 13.7, W 2.9, H 6.7 m, 52 t (H and weight incl. filter system, outdoor). Engine (bare core) weight and dimensions, fuel gas pressure, starter power, lube tank volume/flow/heat rejection, number of variable stator rows, bleed valves, accessory gearbox, engine change time: not published in any opened document - null. No Mercury 50 Turbomachinery Package Specification found on manualsdir.com or scene7; siemens-energy.com and centraxgt.com not consulted (other manufacturers' sites, no Solar documents expected). Mercury 50 is GS only (no MD record).
